thread:
maria: Anyone else seeing big latency spikes after the connpool semaphore tweak on the async Python client? lots of 502/timeout churn in prod since last deploy :thinking_face:
kevin: Seeing an uptick in 5xx traces in datadog too. Did we change default semaphore/prioritization in the recent PR?@maria can you paste the error sample?
maria: repro log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T22:13:02Z ERROR request=abc123 pool_wait=312ms attempt=1 error=TimeoutError: request timed out after 5s
2026-03-20T22:13:02Z INFO inflight=112 pool_semaphore=16 queue_len=96
```
kevin: Wait pool_semaphore=16?? That seems low for the traffic. Which release rolled that out?
maria: deploy-bot: deployed rw-python-sdk v1.5.0 to prod at 22:10 UTC (seen in deploy logs). The change was in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-python-sdk/pull/421 (semaphore prioritization + idle-lease window)
lina: Could be the new prioritization logic starving background reconnects / keepalive maintenance. When semaphore << peak concurrency we can end up queueing many short requests which inflate latency.
chris: Also watch for session lease lifetime. If sessions are aggressively reaped we get connection churn + TLS handshakes. Any timeseries for TCP established vs resets?
maria: TCP resets spiked right after deploy. attaching quick CPU/conn diff: 
- established: -12%
- resets: +230%
- avg latency: +180ms
nirav: Repro steps I ran locally: 
1) checkout PR 421
2) run `python bench.py --clients 200 --rps 400 --keepalive 60`
3) observe 10-30% requests 5xx after ~30s

bench.py snippet:
```
async def worker(client):
    for _ in range(1000):
        await client.generate("short prompt")
```
works on master but fails on pr421 on my laptop with uvloop.
kevin: Good repro. Two quick mitigation ideas: bump semaphore env var so prioritization has more headroom, or revert prioritization flags until we fix starvation.
maria: Confirmed: setting env `RW_POOL_SEMAPHORE=256` on a small canary brought latency back down immediately.
lina: Noted workaround. We should push a hotfix to lower-risk behavior: revert the idle-lease window reaping for now and keep the prioritization opt-in.
chris: Might also be worth adding a telemetry counter for "pool_wait_time_ms" and an alert when p95 > 100ms, so this is caught before prod impact.
nirav: I filed an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-python-sdk/issues/410 with repro and logs. Assigning to @kevin and @maria for triage.
kevin: I'll open a small revert PR to drop the reaper change and also add a runtime flag `enable_idle_reaper=false` behind a feature toggle.
maria: Thx. For the short term we patched canary and rolled config env to 256 everywhere. Monitoring now, looks stable :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollout v1.5.1 (config patch) started at 22:42 UTC.
lina: Follow-ups: add unit test for semaphore starvation scenario, add integration test with scaled short-lived requests, and document recommended env defaults in SDK quickstart (devex).
maria: I'll update the devex sample app and add a note in onboarding about pool config and SESSION_LIFETIME.
kevin: Ping me when you have the PR and I will review. Thanks for the quick triage team :pray:
